_comment: INTENT RECORD and PARTIAL desk bytes for the Board P r3 20 V / 5 A unit (dec PWR-D3 = D3-A, PWR-D5 = D5-1). Not an image to program: status BLOCKED. Never written to any part or read back.
status: BLOCKED (TDISPAR0V value is an owner choice and not set; POWER_ONLY_ABOVE_5V position conflicts with the ST note; no reviewed image)

intent.PDO2: 20.00 V, 5.00 A; needs a 5 A e-marked cable and a source offering 20 V / 5 A
intent.TDISPAR0V: >= 13 so the 2 kOhm VBUS_VS_DISCH feed reaches vSafe0V (default 9 gives >= 630 ms, too short)
intent.accept_or_refuse: VBUS_OUT only on a 20 V contract at 5 A; any lower-current 20 V contract must leave Q1 off (no degraded mode)

field_evidence.position: NVM 0xCA = sector 1 byte 2, bits [7:4] DISCHARGE_TIME_TO_0V; bits [3:0] VBUS_DISCH_TIME_TO_PDO (TDISPARPDO); default 0x9C
field_evidence.source: ST technical note TNxxx "STUSB4500 NVM registers, description and generic access", pages 5 and 22; PDF sha256 a1f35ffea672cef0a32bbd818dd7f5795cfe4bd641960bbf70a5b2374a3927e4; attached by an ST technical moderator, ST Community thread 157984 (2025-10-13)

candidates.13: 0xDC: TDISUSB0V min 0.910 s against 0.906 s needed (0.4 % margin)

field_evidence.not_applied: Owner selects the value; the partial bytes keep the default 0x9C

field_evidence.finding: DS12499 section 3.3.2: a match needs V(SNK_PDOi) = V(SRC_PDOj) and I(SNK_PDOi) <= I(SRC_PDOj). A 20 V offer below 5 A does not match PDO2 = 20 V / 5 A, so the contract falls to 5 V (PDO1, or a mismatch RDO at 5 V). With POWER_ONLY_ABOVE_5V = 1, VBUS_EN_SNK stays Hi-Z without a PDO2 or PDO3 contract (Table 6, section 6.1.2), so Q1 stays off.
field_evidence.source: DS12499 Rev 2 (2018-07), Farnell mirror datasheets/2710898.pdf, sha256 650afb8fd690f996d3075451efc6621c8f22ab05b52a77e08baf0488ea6ada59; Rev 8 recheck NOT RUN (st.com and web.archive.org unreachable from the research container)
field_evidence.residual: A source that later re-advertises 20 V below 5 A during a 20 V contract: the transition behaviour of VBUS_EN_SNK is not stated (bench T8)

field_evidence.finding: Set here and in the P15 image at 0xE6 = sector 4 byte 6 bit 3 (third-party map). The ST note lists 0xE6 [3:0] as RESERVED 0x0; the only other location statement is a non-ST user GUI diff (ST Community thread 32193, 2023-11-02). Needs an ST statement or a bench readback of a GUI-exported image.

base_and_field_map: scripts/pcb/board-p15/nvm-image.py (BASE, decode, setbits; THIRD_PARTY map, Rev 7 default cross-check PASS)
